dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity perimeters with high-contrast sharp transitions from bright edges to dark interior pixels; perimeter edges are non-uniform in thickness and exhibit high-frequency jaggedness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity pixels lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the mid-lateral and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Prominent scalene triangle formed by the centroids of three large dorsal-lateral macro-annuli; secondary curvilinear alignment of five high-intensity blobs following the ventral-lateral contour.
